title: Sharp Markov–Bernstein inequality in Gauss space for p≥2
line: Written-up proof. Prompted and discussed together with Alexandros Eskenazis.

title: An explicit Bellman function for disjoint partitions: the sharp logarithmic gain for three families
line: Written-up proof with verification code.

title: Sharp linear hypercontractivity for ultraspherical measures
line: Written-up proof.

title: Counterexample to Sedykh and Shapiro conjecture
line: Written-up counterexample.

title: Short, computer-free proofs of three nonlinear-mean inequalities of Nazarov, Vasyunin and Volberg
line: Hand proofs of the I3, I4 and I6 inequalities of arXiv:2204.01336; an independent hostile audit found no errors.

title: The Sánchez-Ruiz entropy bound for all harmonic-oscillator eigenstates: a proof of his Eqs. (30) and (37)
line: Proof of Eq. (37) of Sánchez-Ruiz (1997); rated valid by an independent auditor.

title: The sin-omial integral: a one-page elementary proof
line: Two short proofs of (1/π)∫<sub>0</sub><sup>π</sup> sin<sup>r</sup>x / (sin<sup>s</sup>(sx/r) sin<sup>r−s</sup>((r−s)x/r)) dx = binom(r,s); both rated valid by an independent auditor.

title: Ball’s integral inequality via weighted level sets
line: A short new proof of K. Ball’s 1986 inequality for ∫|sin t / t|<sup>s</sup>, s≥2; rated valid by an independent auditor.

title: AND testing with square-root loss: the optimal ε–δ dependence is Θ(√ε), and polynomial bounds for all approximate polymorphisms
line: Rated valid by an independent auditor and a referee.

title: The Keller–Klein Berry–Esseen conjecture: the reachable half for all Rademacher sums, and the full conjecture for a<sub>1</sub>≥0.07
line: Computer-assisted (ball arithmetic); rated valid by an independent auditor and a referee. The full conjecture for a<sub>1</sub><0.07 remains open.

title: List-decoding thresholds of approximate polymorphisms
line: Shows that a lemma (5.6) in the CFMMS paper is false and that the upper threshold s<sup>U</sup> is not tight; rated valid by an independent auditor and a referee.

title: A sharp reverse Khinchin-type inequality for biased bits: the optimal constant R(q) for every q∈(0,1)
line: Computer-assisted; rated valid by an independent referee and an auditor. Several agents worked on it over several days. The original output was 192 pages long. Theorem 1.1 is formalized in Lean 4: for every q∈(0,1), the best constant R(q) in E|∑αiχi| ≤ R(q)‖α‖2, with χi=(Xi−q)/√(q(1−q)) for i.i.d. Xi∼Bernoulli(q), is 2√(q(1−q)) maxk≥1 √k max(q,1−q)k−1, attained by equal coefficients on k=⌊1/(p(2−p))⌋ coordinates, p=min(q,1−q). The Lean theorem ReverseKhinchin.mainTheorem states all of Theorem 1.1 and uses only the standard axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; the Lean kernel checks every certificate. The 823 Lean files have about 534,000 lines: 508,000 (720 files) of machine-generated certificate data and 26,000 (103 files) of proof code. An independent referee rated the formalization valid after building it from source with Lean v4.35.0 and re-checking it with the external checker nanoda, except for the certificate computations, which a second checker re-checked on a random sample of 16 certificate modules. Not formalized: Theorem 10.1 and the characterization of the equality cases; Theorems 13.11 and 14.1 are replaced by one statement with new certificates, and Theorem 15.1 is proved with 8551/10000 in place of 171/200, so the formalization should be cited for Theorem 1.1 only.

title: Sharp L<sup>1</sup> Poincaré inequality on the Hamming cube
line: An explanation of the proof, based on Tomar’s preprint.

title: No 421 equiangular lines in R<sup>44</sup>, no 94 in R<sup>20</sup>, no 74 in R<sup>19</sup> and no 59 in R<sup>18</sup>
line: N(44)≤420 and N(20)≤93 are rated valid by an independent auditor and a referee; N(19)≤73 and N(18)≤58 have not been refereed yet.

title: The exact Rosenthal bound for independent zero-mean summands when 3≤p≤4, and in the two extreme regimes when 4<p<5
line: Independent adversarial referee passes found no critical or major issues; the middle regime of 4<p<5 is open.

title: Carathéodory numbers of the Barvinok–Novik orbitopes, of all four-dimensional SO(2)-orbitopes, and of a further family
line: Not refereed.

title: On the Améndola–Lee–Meroni conjecture: the signature volume formula on all subpaths does not characterize cyclic curves
line: Claims a counterexample to the conjecture. Not refereed.

title: The local neighborliness threshold of the symmetric moment curve, and the Barvinok–Lee–Novik conjecture for k≤440 and all sufficiently large k
line: Not refereed; the conjecture for intermediate k is open.

title: Complex hypercontractivity for several correlated Gaussian functions below the diagonal
line: Three parts: an exact criterion for imaginary parameters and every outer exponent; the exact imaginary-axis region for two ρ-correlated functions; and joint narrow-bump counterexamples for general complex z, with two failure points certified in ball arithmetic. Not refereed; off the axes only inner and outer bounds are proved, the region between them is open, and the remaining numerical facts are stated only as evidence.

title: A non-degenerate Gaussian kernel without Gaussian maximisers: Lieb’s formula fails below the diagonal
line: An Arb-certified counterexample to Lieb’s formula below the diagonal (p>q, genuinely complex case): for the Mehler transform with z=0.72e<sup>0.7i</sup> from L<sup>p</sup> to L<sup>4</sup>, p≥16, every Gaussian satisfies the inequality but a unimodular function violates it. Rated valid by an independent referee.

title: Correlated forward hypercontractivity with outer exponent α<1
line: With equal parameters and equal exponents p≥1, the Ivanisvili–Kalantzopoulos covariance condition is necessary and sufficient for every α∈(0,1). With unequal parameters it is not sufficient for r=αp>2; whether it is sufficient for r∈(0,2]∖{1} is open.

title: A comparison inequality for Gaussian vectors and product functions
line: Sufficient conditions for the comparison inequality are refereed; in an explicit example the exact threshold is open on [2.175…, 2.1925).

title: The Maurey–Pisier problem for Bourgain–Milman–Wolfson type
line: For every p∈(1,2), a metric space with supremal BMW type exponent p into which the discrete ℓ<sub>p</sub> cubes do not embed with uniformly bounded distortion, a negative answer to the Maurey–Pisier problem for BMW type; also an exact characterization of the metric spaces that contain these cubes uniformly. Obtained by Nika Areshidze.

title: On the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture: a quasi-polynomial bound
line: MaxInf(f) ≥ (Var f/d)<sup>O(log d)</sup>·exp(−O(log<sup>4</sup> d)) for every Boolean f of degree d (Theorem 10.1). Written-up proof; the integrated notes and paper text were independently audited.

title: A short proof that the Boolean Bohnenblust–Hille constant is at most d<sup>2</sup>(log d)<sup>3/2+o(1)</sup>
line: BH(d) ≤ C d<sup>2</sup>(1+log d)<sup>3/2</sup> λ(d)<sup>3/2</sup>(1+log λ(d))<sup>1/4</sup>, where λ(d)=1+log(1+log d), and also BH(d) ≤ C d<sup>2</sup>(1+log d)<sup>2</sup> λ(d)<sup>1/4</sup>. The power of d remains 2. Independent AI audits of the argument found no gap.
